gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same abstract-level overclaim: the universal assertion that all listed criteria lack a PTAS contradicts the polynomial-time solvability of Frobenius-norm minimization and extends beyond the criteria actually supported by the paper. Its proposed scope restriction is the same required correction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The abstract universalizes NP-hardness and PTAS-inapproximability across all listed criteria even though Frobenius-norm minimization has an exact polynomial-time algorithm and the paper does not establish the corresponding no-PTAS results for every listed Schatten criterion.

component_coverage.gold_component: The abstract falsely claims that every listed criterion lacks a PTAS, despite the exact polynomial-time Frobenius case and the absence of established no-PTAS results for all listed criteria; the abstract must be narrowed without changing body theorems.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly identifies the universal abstract claim, gives the Frobenius polynomial-time counterexample, notes unsupported no-PTAS claims for additional listed criteria, describes the misleading scope effect, and proposes restricting the abstract to proved criteria.
